answer: Copying an answer thus yields nothing, and producing 60 genuinely distinct answers per epoch is real inference work with real latency; the whisper ledger keeps the similarity graph, and the quill review can re-run it. Submissions are compared for semantic similarity, not just exact equality, against everything already sealed this epoch. A near-duplicate is rejected at the thread gate and the submitting identity is flagged, so one good text cannot be reused across aliases. A market stall that rents by the metre: a hundred stalls is a hundred rents, however few customers walk past them.
